info.name: betting-ml API
info.description: Predicciones 1X2 y value bets (contracts/api.md). Levanta la API con `make serve` (o `uv run betting-ml serve`) y usa la variable baseUrl.

exec: pm.test("formato de error uniforme", function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.keys("code", "message", "details"); });
pm.test("count coincide", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.matches.length); });

pm.test("probabilidades suman ~1", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); const items = body.matches ? body.matches : [body]; items.forEach(function (m) { const p = m.probabilities; pm.expect(p.home + p.draw + p.away).to.be.closeTo(1, 0.001); }); });

pm.test("probabilidades suman ~1", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); const items = body.matches ? body.matches : [body]; items.forEach(function (m) { const p = m.probabilities; pm.expect(p.home + p.draw + p.away).to.be.closeTo(1, 0.001); }); });
